question: To what kind of person who has been tested over the course of one year must a certain teaching be given?
premises: A certain teaching is fit to be given.
That teaching is only for one previously accomplished in the practice.
Such a person must first be tested for one full year.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one previously accomplished who has been tested for one year.
uncertainties: Criteria for prior accomplishment remain unspecified
plain_english: This teaching is to be given only to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
